newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-FRANCE AND BRAZIL SHARE SPOILS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FRANCE AND BRAZIL SHARE SPOILS.

text.p: World champions Brazil and 1998 World Cup hosts France drew 1-1 in the opening match of the four-team Tournoi de France on Tuesday.

Real Madrid's Roberto Carlos put Brazil ahead in the 21st minute with a spctacular free kick, just to the right of centre and about 35 metres out, which curled round France's four-man wall and in off Fabien Barthez's left post with the surprised Monaco goalkeeper rooted to the spot.

France equalised on the hour when Ibrahim Ba darted through on the right and fed Lyon's Florian Maurice, whose low shot was blocked by the diving Taffarel. But fellow striker Marc Keller of German club Karlsruhe pounced on the loose ball to nudge it into the net.
England and Italy, rivals in the same World Cup qualifying group, meet in the second match of the June 3-11 tournament, a dress rehearsal for next year's World Cup finals, in Nantes on Wednesday.
